projectDescription: A B2B marketplace for industrial waste and surplus materials in Paraguay, connecting waste generators with recyclers under a circular economy framework and Paraguay's Ley N.° 3956/2009.
keyFeatures: Public marketplace catalog with geographic filtering by Paraguay department/city
Full offer and counter-offer negotiation cycle between generators and recyclers
Contract lifecycle management with PDF generation and QR-verifiable documents
Unified payment gateway abstraction supporting Pagopar, DLocalGo, and a simulated gateway
RUC validation against the Paraguay DNIT taxpayer registry (local import)
Environmental license validation via SIAM (MADES online API)
CO2 savings estimation and ODS metrics tracking for circular economy reporting
Role-based access control with three Filament 5 panels (Admin, Generador, Reciclador)
ARCO privacy rights compliance (Ley N.° 7.593/2025) with data export and erasure
Traceability index across seven supply chain checkpoints
Automated background jobs: padron import, OCR license parsing, RUC batch validation
Dockerized deployment with PostgreSQL 16, queue worker, and scheduler containers
publicApiSurface: GET /marketplace — public catalog with filters (material, city, price range)
GET /marketplace/empresa/{id} — company profile with its lots
GET /marketplace/nearby/{id} — lots near a given lot (5 km radius)
POST /login — unified login with role-based redirect to /portal
POST /portal/marketplace/ofertas/{lote} — submit an offer on a lot
PaymentGateway::iniciar(Contrato, User): array — start a payment transaction
PaymentGateway::procesarWebhook(array, string): array — process gateway webhook
OfertaService::crearOferta(LotePublicado, int, int, array, CanalOferta): Oferta
TrazabilidadService — traceability index across 7 supply chain checkpoints
